scope: Per-resource-group and call-tag random table range selection.

validation.case_scope: A compact fixture checks actor-group resolution, direct group mapping and clamping, inclusive signed range selection, independent per-tag cursors, the 32768-entry wrap and invalid/equal endpoints. Synthetic random values are used. Resource lookup remains a service boundary and existing callers are not yet composed; no statistical or native runtime validation is claimed. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
